outcomes: Anyone can install and inspect the public agent-readiness CLI and collector independently of hosted Intelligence, then inspect its private payload or obtain a scored report from the existing service.
nonGoals: Moving server-side scoring, report storage, report UI, hosted Intelligence commands or the published method.
Changing marker definitions, thresholds or public support status.

requirements.text: The separately installable extension runs without a workspace, account, cloud setup or private Go module; its runtime identifies @putnami/agent-readiness.

Collection reads committed Git history, emits schema v1 method 0.4 counts and repository-relative paths, checks privacy before output or submission, leaves the repository untouched, and print-payload performs no network request.

Submission sends the exact collected payload bytes anonymously to the existing reports endpoint once, renders the returned verdict and link, and returns an API error for failed or invalid responses; timeout and structured output follow the shared CLI contract.
